evidence: Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 [environment] contains exactly build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096; no docker_image key. tomllib parse confirms d['environment'] = {'build_timeout_sec': 600.0, 'network_mode': 'public', 'cpus': 2, 'memory_mb': 4096} and [verifier.environment] = {'network_mode': 'public'} (also no image). A recursive grep for docker_image / 'image =' / compose files over the frozen task found none (only an unrelated criterion id hro_msg_compose in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:303). The agent Dockerfile task/environment/Dockerfile:1-26 has active build steps (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim; apt install; npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1; COPY instructions/ and assets/; chmod + git-init /app), so it is the image that is built and nothing shadows it. The task's [environment] block and agent Dockerfile are byte-identical in content to the frozen template (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml:20-24, environment/Dockerfile:1-26), satisfying staged-task-contract.md:78. Adversarial consideration: a broken setup would add docker_image = "<prebuilt>" so the Dockerfile's /instructions, /assets and /app init are silently skipped; that is absent here. No conforming alternative could fail this row because it is a pure task-configuration property independent of the submitted app. This is a static configuration check; no runtime evidence is required for it, and no Docker build was performed by this reviewer (Oracle/judge/model scores are not claimed).
